ops.body:
Accept as known limit
Question: Remote Go r4 is frozen: diff 5e0b76f4, delta 3df103d4, 11 files +795/-230, test opt-in restored. Its sol finder found 3 majors and 1 minor. (1) r4 changed routing.go:192 to Go's 4-byte GOFLAGS tokenizer, but withoutParallelism (gobuild.go:192) still uses strings.Fields, so a \v inside a flag value now routes and is forwarded corrupted. This is a regression r4 introduced. (2) An ELOOP ancestor is LOCAL in the engine but missing to the shim. (3) The quoted-GOFLAGS row still cannot fail. (4) Config ordering: a present but invalid config (bad duration, malformed JSON) makes the engine exit 75 before classifying, while the shim's cgo/library LOCAL gate runs local. How should config parity be fixed in r5?
Options: Engine classifies first (Recommended) | Accept as known limit | Shim validates config
